incomplete_fix_quote: The CVE-2026-30869 fix only added a denylist check (IsSensitivePath) but did not address the root cause, a redundant url.PathUnescape() call in serveExport(). Because it is a denylist it fails to protect other sensitive files (e.g. *.db/*.log and plain workspace files) reachable by the same %252e%252e double-encoded traversal.
auth_note: empty AccessAuthCode + SIYUAN_ACCESS_AUTH_CODE_BYPASS=true grants admin; auth-orthogonal to the traversal.
